title: Patellar Tilt

positions.as_written: Measure on axial images at a stated flexion angle, because tilt reduces as the patella engages.
Use a defined femoral reference line, usually the posterior condylar line, and state which.
Measure the patellar axis consistently, since the patella's shape makes this less obvious than it sounds.
Assess the lateral retinaculum, which is the structure tilt reflects.
Assess the other measurements alongside, since tilt rarely occurs alone.
Say that the reference line must be named.
